overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused multi-platform presence across academic and professional networks (LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon) totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet), and academic recruitment. Across all 7 analyzed posts, content achieves high engagement due to targeted, high-value academic and career announcements.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new research papers, methodology studies, and software updates like CooRnet v2.0.
Posts advertising open postdoctoral and PhD research positions in computational social science.
Discussions on methodological approaches for identifying platform manipulation and information operations.

recommendations: Cross-post successful hiring and opportunity announcements across all platforms to maximize applicant reach.
Increase content frequency on Bluesky where engagement rates per follower are currently highest.
Utilize visual aids (data charts, paper figures, project logos) to boost engagement on text-focused posts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest overall engagement rate (6.14%), driven by strong re-post rates on publications and PhD opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, active audience showing steady interest in tool releases and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest audience reach (1,850 followers) with high absolute engagement on major milestones like research grants and job openings.
